items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Relative img src/srcset/source srcset/video poster, CSS url() (image+font) and @import are inlined as data URIs/text for project pages AND for pages outside the project (session-file route with assetOf). No scripts, no video/audio, no style attributes (documented).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every fetch is bounded by a 5s abort; a refused/missing/over-budget file keeps the original reference; the inliner never throws into the render path (.catch -> raw html). Covered by unit tests incl. stalled request and 403/404.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Server: an asset is served only for an EVIDENCED .html owner, image/css/font extension, lexical + realpath containment in the owner folder, no dot segment, not sensitive, owner folder not a filesystem root or home. Client: loader requests only image/font extensions and never from dot segments; </style escaped; all regexes literal (Semgrep ratchet). The scripted page cannot call the file API itself (CSP connect-src none, opaque origin). Residual: images/css named by a page in its own folder tree are readable by that page (accepted, ADR).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Server route tests (9) incl. traversal, symlink, hidden dirs, wrong types, unevidenced owner, broad folder; client unit tests (15+) for tags, srcset, CSS url/@import depth+cycles, path resolution, loader bounds; real-browser E2E on the real server for a project page and an outside page (inline + pop-out) verified RED when image loading is sabotaged.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Distinct files fetched once in parallel, capped at 40 files / 20 MB total / 5s each; srcset and CSS regexes are linear (disjoint-start alternations); masker is the existing linear scanner.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Split into htmlMarkupScan / htmlInlineStyles / htmlInlineAssets / htmlResourceLoader / inlineHtmlResources (all well under 300 lines); server rule in its own asset-access.ts; access.ts only exports WIN_DEVICE.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: New query parameter assetOf on GET /tasks/:id/session-file: producer sessionFileUrl() and consumer route exercised together by the real-server E2E (owner evidenced -> 200 image/png; unevidenced owner / script / parent folder -> 403).

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff: no findings; the symlink test fails (not skips) in CI when symlinks cannot be created.
